text: Atkins Avenue residents submitted a petition to my office in late May 2018 requesting more restrictive permit parking regulations on their street. By extending the overnight on-street permit parking hours and introducing a one hour maximum parking duration, residents will have improved parking flexibility and the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, can effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the extension of permit parking hours of operation on Atkins Avenue, between Brock Street and Sheridan Avenue from the current 7:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m., Monday to Friday and 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Saturday and 9:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. Sundays to the new hours of 4:00 p.m. to 8:00 a.m., 7 days a week. 2. Approved the introduction of a 1-hour maximum parking duration between 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m., 7 days a week on Atkins Avenue, between Brock Avenue and Sheridan Avenue.
